title: @c15t/ui: Cookie consent UI primitives and theme system
description: The framework-agnostic cookie consent UI primitives, CSS, and theme tokens behind the c15t React, Vue, Svelte, and Astro components. Most apps get this package through a framework adapter and do not install it directly.
features: One theme system for every c15t framework: set `--c15t-*` tokens once and the banner, dialog, and preference center follow
Stylesheets for plain CSS and Tailwind CSS, with a separate file for Tailwind CSS 3
Framework-agnostic primitives for building a c15t adapter for another UI framework
manualInstallation: The framework packages (`c15t/react`, `c15t/vue`, `c15t/astro`, `@c15t/svelte`) depend on this package and re-export its stylesheets. Install it directly only to build your own adapter:
